name: Sylheti Tangy Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Vegetable oil (e.g. canola, sunflower, or olive oil)

steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large pan.
Add the garlic, and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the onion paste and cook until it turns golden brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook until they become soft and the oil begins to separate.
Mix in turmeric and salt according to your taste.
Pour in the boiling water, and let the curry simmer until it reaches your desired consistency.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
